name: Trend-aligned squeeze: deep-negative funding within an intact uptrend (NOT trend-filter-alone)
rationale: Thesis: the highest-quality squeeze is a crowded-short flush that occurs WITHIN a still-intact uptrend — shorts fading a healthy market get squeezed hardest as the primary trend reasserts. Combine a slow trend filter with the positioning gate, timing entries to the crowded-short pullback rather than chasing. Entry (long-only spot): ret_Nd over a LONG lookback > a trend floor (uptrend intact) AND funding_rate < deeply-negative floor [-0.004,-0.0005] (crowded shorts fading the trend). DISCONFIRMER: must beat the long-lookback trend filter ALONE with the SAME lookback and floor and no funding gate — if lone trend-following matches net Sharpe, the funding pullback-timing gate is worthless. The positioning gate is the claim: it must beat continuous trend exposure by entering only on the crowded-short dips. funding_feature null — level, not carry. Exit on the trend breaking down or funding normalizing up.
catalyst: crowded-short funding flush during an intact longer-term uptrend
